channel.title: Human 2.0 — Build notes
channel.description: Build notes for Human 2.0, an operating manual for the agent age. The full draft reads free in the one-word reader.

item.title: Part I — Crash course: the mechanics behind capable agents
item.description: Six chapters on models, context, tools, verification, cost, and alignment — only the mechanics needed to operate agents. Readable now in the reader.

item.title: Part II — Human 2.0 in the wild: field notes from a working six-agent lab
item.description: Eight first-person chapters: vibe-coding, the small factory, remote agents, the job search, security, and the first-try problem. Readable now in the reader.

item.title: Part III — Running the day: an operating loop for action and judgment
item.description: Six chapters on the Direct → Route → Execute → Verify → Learn loop, ending with what must stay human. Readable now in the reader.
